ios.desc:
Cameramark reads your photo's Exif data and adds it — camera logo, model, lens, shooting settings, and more — to a frame around the photo, without compressing the resolution.

If a photo has no Exif data, you can enter the info yourself and save your settings as a preset for quick switching.

You can also read Fujifilm film simulations, turn GPS coordinates into a place name, add a signature or handwriting, upload your own logo, and add frames to multiple photos at once. Presets sync via iCloud.

Cameramark supports all major digital cameras and most film cameras.

* Cameramark's Japanese version was translated by Kazuto Okumura. Thank you very much!
